## Specification

### Component: Stepper

Progress through a multi-step flow. Steps before `value` are complete, `value` is current, the rest are upcoming.

#### Anatomy
```
<Stepper value defaultValue onValueChange orientation clickable>   ol.ui-stepper data-orientation
  <StepperItem step state? disabled?>                             li.ui-stepper-item data-state="complete|current|upcoming"
    <StepperTrigger>                                              button.ui-stepper-trigger (clickable) | div.ui-stepper-trigger — aria-current="step" on the current one
      <StepperIndicator />                                        span.ui-stepper-indicator aria-hidden — step number, or an SVG check when complete
      <StepperContent>                                            div.ui-stepper-text
        <StepperTitle />  <StepperDescription />                  span.ui-stepper-title / span.ui-stepper-description
    <StepperSeparator />                                          div.ui-stepper-separator data-state="complete|incomplete" (omit on the last step)
```

#### Props
- `Stepper`: `value` / `defaultValue` (1-based, default 1) / `onValueChange`; `orientation` (`horizontal` | `vertical`); `clickable` (default: true when `onValueChange` is set).
- `StepperItem`: `step` (required), `state` (override), `disabled`.
- State = `complete` if `step < value`, `current` if equal, else `upcoming`. The separator is `complete` when its item is.

#### Behaviour
- Clickable: triggers are buttons; click calls `onValueChange(step)`. `disabled` items cannot be chosen. Roving arrow keys (←→ horizontal, ↑↓ vertical), Home / End, over the enabled buttons; no typeahead.
- Not clickable: triggers are plain `div`s (not focusable).
- A complete title has a hidden " (completed)" suffix (`sr-only`).

#### Visual rules
- Indicator: 28px circle, 1.5px `--ui-border-strong` border, `--ui-surface`, number 13px/500 tabular, muted.
- Current: border `--ui-primary`, number `--ui-foreground`, 4px ring of `--ui-primary` at 14%. Complete: fill `--ui-primary`, check in `--ui-primary-foreground`.
- Title 14px/500 (muted when upcoming), description 13px muted. Trigger gap 10px.
- Separator: 2px line `--ui-border` (flex-1, min 24px); fill `--ui-primary`. Vertical: 2px × 28px line, left-aligned under the indicator's centre; items stack with 6px gap.
- Under 640px (horizontal) only the current step keeps its text.
- Focus ring `0 0 0 3px` of `--ui-ring` at 45%.

#### Motion
- Check: stroke draws in (`ui-draw`, `pathLength=1`) over 320ms after 60ms. Indicator colours 220ms.
- Separator fill: `scaleX(0 → 1)` (`scaleY` vertical) on `--ui-spring-smooth` / `--ui-spring-smooth-duration`, origin at the start. Reduced motion jumps.

#### Accessibility
- Ordered list; the current step `aria-current="step"`. Indicators are decorative.

#### Acceptance checks
- Going forward turns the number into a check and fills the line; going back reverses it.
- Disabled upcoming steps cannot be clicked or reached with arrow keys.
- Exactly one element has `aria-current="step"`.
- At 390px the horizontal stepper fits without scrolling.

### `ui/components/stepper/stepper.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  forwardRef,
  useContext,
  useMemo,
  type ButtonHTMLAttributes,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type LiHTMLAttributes,
  type OlHTMLAttributes,
} from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { useRovingFocus } from '../../hooks/use-roving-focus';

export type StepperOrientation = 'horizontal' | 'vertical';
export type StepState = 'complete' | 'current' | 'upcoming';

interface StepperContextValue {
  value: number;
  setValue: (value: number) => void;
  orientation: StepperOrientation;
  clickable: boolean;
}

interface StepItemContextValue {
  step: number;
  state: StepState;
  disabled: boolean;
}

const StepperContext = createContext<StepperContextValue | null>(null);
const StepItemContext = createContext<StepItemContextValue | null>(null);

function useStepper(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(StepperContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <Stepper>.`);
  return ctx;
}

function useStepItem(component: string) {
  const ctx = useContext(StepItemContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error(`<${component}> must be used inside <StepperItem>.`);
  return ctx;
}

export interface StepperProps extends Omit<OlHTMLAttributes<HTMLOListElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange'> {
  /** The current step, 1-based. Steps before it are complete. */
  value?: number;
  /** Initial step when uncontrolled. Default 1. */
  defaultValue?: number;
  /** Called when a step is chosen (steps are only clickable when this is set or `clickable` is true). */
  onValueChange?: (value: number) => void;
  /** Layout direction. Default `horizontal`. */
  orientation?: StepperOrientation;
  /** Make the steps buttons. Defaults to true when `onValueChange` is given. */
  clickable?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Stepper — progress through a multi-step flow. Steps before `value` are
 * complete, `value` is the current step, the rest are upcoming. When the steps
 * are clickable they are real buttons with arrow-key movement between them.
 */
export const Stepper = forwardRef<HTMLOListElement, StepperProps>(function Stepper(
  {
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue = 1,
    onValueChange,
    orientation = 'horizontal',
    clickable,
    className,
    onKeyDown,
    children,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onChange: onValueChange });
  const isClickable = clickable ?? onValueChange !== undefined;
  const rove = useRovingFocus({
    itemSelector: 'button.ui-stepper-trigger',
    orientation,
    typeahead: false,
  });
  const ctx = useMemo(
    () => ({ value, setValue, orientation, clickable: isClickable }),
    [value, setValue, orientation, isClickable],
  );
  return (
    <StepperContext.Provider value={ctx}>
      <ol
        ref={ref}
        data-orientation={orientation}
        className={cn('ui-stepper', className)}
        onKeyDown={(e) => {
          onKeyDown?.(e);
          if (!e.defaultPrevented && isClickable) rove(e);
        }}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </ol>
    </StepperContext.Provider>
  );
});

export interface StepperItemProps extends LiHTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement> {
  /** This step's number, 1-based. */
  step: number;
  /** Override the state worked out from the stepper's value (e.g. mark an error or a skipped step). */
  state?: StepState;
  /** Not selectable (only matters when steps are clickable). */
  disabled?: boolean;
}

export const StepperItem = forwardRef<HTMLLIElement, StepperItemProps>(function StepperItem(
  { step, state: stateProp, disabled = false, className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const stepper = useStepper('StepperItem');
  const state: StepState = stateProp ?? (step < stepper.value ? 'complete' : step === stepper.value ? 'current' : 'upcoming');
  const ctx = useMemo(() => ({ step, state, disabled }), [step, state, disabled]);
  return (
    <StepItemContext.Provider value={ctx}>
      <li
        ref={ref}
        data-state={state}
        data-orientation={stepper.orientation}
        className={cn('ui-stepper-item', className)}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
      </li>
    </StepItemContext.Provider>
  );
});

/**
 * The part of a step you can press: indicator and text. A `<button>` when the
 * stepper is clickable, otherwise a plain `<div>`. Marks the current step with `aria-current="step"`.
 */
export const StepperTrigger = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>>(function StepperTrigger(
  { className, onClick, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const stepper = useStepper('StepperTrigger');
  const item = useStepItem('StepperTrigger');
  const current = item.state === 'current' ? 'step' : undefined;
  if (!stepper.clickable) {
    return (
      <div
        ref={ref as never}
        className={cn('ui-stepper-trigger', className)}
        aria-current={current}
        {...(props as HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>)}
      >
        {children}
      </div>
    );
  }
  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      type="button"
      disabled={item.disabled}
      aria-current={current}
      className={cn('ui-stepper-trigger', className)}
      onClick={(e) => {
        onClick?.(e);
        if (!e.defaultPrevented) stepper.setValue(item.step);
      }}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
});

export interface StepperIndicatorProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement> {}

/** The circle: the step number, turning into a check (drawn in) when the step is complete. */
export const StepperIndicator = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, StepperIndicatorProps>(function StepperIndicator(
  { className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const item = useStepItem('StepperIndicator');
  return (
    <span ref={ref} aria-hidden="true" data-state={item.state} className={cn('ui-stepper-indicator', className)} {...props}>
      {item.state === 'complete' ? (
        <svg
          viewBox="0 0 24 24"
          width="14"
          height="14"
          fill="none"
          stroke="currentColor"
          strokeWidth="2.5"
          strokeLinecap="round"
          strokeLinejoin="round"
          focusable="false"
          className="ui-stepper-check"
        >
          <path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7" pathLength={1} />
        </svg>
      ) : (
        (children ?? item.step)
      )}
    </span>
  );
});

/** Groups the title and description next to the indicator. */
export const StepperContent = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function StepperContent(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <div ref={ref} className={cn('ui-stepper-text', className)} {...props} />;
});

export const StepperTitle = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>>(function StepperTitle(
  { className, children, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const item = useStepItem('StepperTitle');
  return (
    <span ref={ref} className={cn('ui-stepper-title', className)} {...props}>
      {children}
      {item.state === 'complete' && <span className="sr-only"> (completed)</span>}
    </span>
  );
});

export const StepperDescription = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>>(function StepperDescription(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return <span ref={ref} className={cn('ui-stepper-description', className)} {...props} />;
});

/** The line to the next step. It fills (on the smooth spring) once this step is complete. */
export const StepperSeparator = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>>(function StepperSeparator(
  { className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  const item = useStepItem('StepperSeparator');
  return (
    <div
      ref={ref}
      role="presentation"
      aria-hidden="true"
      data-state={item.state === 'complete' ? 'complete' : 'incomplete'}
      className={cn('ui-stepper-separator', className)}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/hooks/use-roving-focus.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';

export type Orientation = 'vertical' | 'horizontal' | 'both';

const isDisabled = (el: HTMLElement) =>
  el.hasAttribute('disabled') || el.getAttribute('aria-disabled') === 'true' || el.hasAttribute('data-disabled');

/**
 * Arrow-key focus movement across items inside a container, with Home/End
 * and typeahead. Spread the returned handler on the container:
 *   const onKeyDown = useRovingFocus({ itemSelector: '[role="menuitem"]' });
 *   <div role="menu" onKeyDown={onKeyDown}>…</div>
 */
export function useRovingFocus({
  itemSelector,
  orientation = 'vertical',
  loop = true,
  typeahead = true,
  onMove,
}: {
  itemSelector: string;
  orientation?: Orientation;
  loop?: boolean;
  typeahead?: boolean;
  onMove?: (item: HTMLElement) => void;
}) {
  const buffer = useRef('');
  const timer = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined>(undefined);

  return useCallback(
    (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
      const items = Array.from(e.currentTarget.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(itemSelector)).filter(
        (el) => !isDisabled(el) && el.getClientRects().length > 0,
      );
      if (!items.length) return;
      const active = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
      const index = items.findIndex((el) => el === active || (active !== null && el.contains(active)));
      const go = (item: HTMLElement | undefined) => {
        if (!item) return;
        e.preventDefault();
        item.focus();
        onMove?.(item);
      };
      const step = (delta: number) => {
        if (index === -1) return items[delta > 0 ? 0 : items.length - 1];
        let next = index + delta;
        if (loop) next = (next + items.length) % items.length;
        else next = Math.max(0, Math.min(items.length - 1, next));
        return items[next];
      };
      const v = orientation !== 'horizontal';
      const h = orientation !== 'vertical';
      switch (e.key) {
        case 'ArrowDown':
          if (v) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowUp':
          if (v) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowRight':
          if (h) go(step(1));
          return;
        case 'ArrowLeft':
          if (h) go(step(-1));
          return;
        case 'Home':
          go(items[0]);
          return;
        case 'End':
          go(items[items.length - 1]);
          return;
      }
      if (!typeahead || e.key.length !== 1 || e.ctrlKey || e.metaKey || e.altKey) return;
      if ((e.target as HTMLElement).matches('input, textarea')) return;
      clearTimeout(timer.current);
      buffer.current += e.key.toLowerCase();
      timer.current = setTimeout(() => {
        buffer.current = '';
      }, 500);
      go(items.find((el) => (el.textContent ?? '').trim().toLowerCase().startsWith(buffer.current)));
    },
    [itemSelector, orientation, loop, typeahead, onMove],
  );
}
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/stepper.css`

```css
/* Stepper -----------------------------------------------------------------
   <ol class="ui-stepper" data-orientation="horizontal|vertical">
     <li class="ui-stepper-item" data-state="complete|current|upcoming">
       <button|div class="ui-stepper-trigger" aria-current="step">
         <span class="ui-stepper-indicator" data-state>  number, or a check that draws in
         <div class="ui-stepper-text"><span class="ui-stepper-title"><span class="ui-stepper-description">
       <div class="ui-stepper-separator" data-state="complete|incomplete">   fills on the smooth spring
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-stepper {
    --ui-stepper-size: 1.75rem;
    display: flex;
    align-items: flex-start;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    list-style: none;
    width: 100%;
  }
  .ui-stepper[data-orientation="vertical"] { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; width: auto; }

  .ui-stepper-item { display: flex; align-items: center; flex: 1 1 auto; min-width: 0; gap: 0.75rem; }
  .ui-stepper-item:last-child { flex: 0 0 auto; }
  .ui-stepper-item[data-orientation="vertical"] { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; gap: 0.375rem; flex: 0 0 auto; }

  .ui-stepper-trigger {
    position: relative;
    display: inline-flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 0.625rem;
    min-width: 0;
    padding: 0.25rem;
    margin: -0.25rem;
    border-radius: var(--radius-md);
    color: inherit;
    text-align: start;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  button.ui-stepper-trigger { cursor: pointer; }
  button.ui-stepper-trigger:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: 0.5; }
  button.ui-stepper-trigger:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }

  .ui-stepper-indicator {
    display: inline-flex;
    flex: none;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: var(--ui-stepper-size);
    height: var(--ui-stepper-size);
    border: 1.5px solid var(--ui-border-strong);
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--ui-surface);
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    font-weight: 500;
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    line-height: 1;
    transition: background-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      border-color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      color var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  .ui-stepper-indicator[data-state="current"] {
    border-color: var(--ui-primary);
    color: var(--ui-foreground);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-primary) 14%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-stepper-indicator[data-state="complete"] {
    border-color: var(--ui-primary);
    background: var(--ui-primary);
    color: var(--ui-primary-foreground);
  }
  .ui-stepper-check path {
    --ui-dash: 1;
    stroke-dasharray: 1;
    stroke-dashoffset: 0;
    animation: ui-draw 320ms var(--ui-ease-out) 60ms backwards;
  }

  .ui-stepper-text { display: grid; min-width: 0; gap: 0.0625rem; }
  .ui-stepper-title { font-size: var(--text-base); font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25rem; color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); transition: color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard); }
  .ui-stepper-item[data-state="current"] .ui-stepper-title,
  .ui-stepper-item[data-state="complete"] .ui-stepper-title { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  .ui-stepper-description { font-size: var(--text-sm); line-height: 1.125rem; color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }

  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    button.ui-stepper-trigger:not(:disabled):hover .ui-stepper-title { color: var(--ui-foreground); }
  }

  /* The line to the next step */
  .ui-stepper-separator {
    position: relative;
    flex: 1 1 0;
    min-width: 1.5rem;
    height: 2px;
    border-radius: 999px;
    background: var(--ui-border);
    overflow: hidden;
  }
  .ui-stepper-separator::after {
    content: "";
    position: absolute;
    inset: 0;
    border-radius: inherit;
    background: var(--ui-primary);
    transform: scaleX(0);
    transform-origin: left center;
    transition: transform var(--ui-spring-smooth-duration) var(--ui-spring-smooth);
  }
  .ui-stepper-separator[data-state="complete"]::after { transform: scaleX(1); }
  .ui-stepper-separator:dir(rtl)::after { transform-origin: right center; }

  .ui-stepper-item[data-orientation="vertical"] > .ui-stepper-separator {
    flex: none;
    width: 2px;
    height: 1.75rem;
    min-width: 0;
    margin-inline-start: calc(var(--ui-stepper-size) / 2 - 1px);
  }
  .ui-stepper-item[data-orientation="vertical"] > .ui-stepper-separator::after {
    transform: scaleY(0);
    transform-origin: center top;
  }
  .ui-stepper-item[data-orientation="vertical"] > .ui-stepper-separator[data-state="complete"]::after { transform: scaleY(1); }

  /* Phones: only the current step shows its text (the others keep it for screen readers), so a horizontal stepper fits */
  @media (max-width: 639px) {
    .ui-stepper[data-orientation="horizontal"] .ui-stepper-item:not([data-state="current"]) .ui-stepper-text {
      position: absolute;
      width: 1px;
      height: 1px;
      overflow: hidden;
      clip: rect(0 0 0 0);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
  }
}
```

## Usage

**Checkout** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/stepper/checkout.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/ui/components/button';
import { Stepper, StepperContent, StepperDescription, StepperIndicator, StepperItem, StepperSeparator, StepperTitle, StepperTrigger } from '@/ui/components/stepper';

const steps = [
  { title: 'Cart', description: '3 items, $184.00' },
  { title: 'Shipping', description: 'Address and delivery' },
  { title: 'Payment', description: 'Card details' },
  { title: 'Review', description: 'Confirm your order' },
];

export default function StepperCheckout() {
  const [step, setStep] = useState(2);
  const done = step > steps.length;
  return (
    <div className="grid gap-6">
      <Stepper value={step} onValueChange={setStep} aria-label="Checkout progress">
        {steps.map((s, i) => (
          <StepperItem key={s.title} step={i + 1} disabled={i + 1 > step}>
            <StepperTrigger>
              <StepperIndicator />
              <StepperContent>
                <StepperTitle>{s.title}</StepperTitle>
                <StepperDescription>{s.description}</StepperDescription>
              </StepperContent>
            </StepperTrigger>
            {i < steps.length - 1 && <StepperSeparator />}
          </StepperItem>
        ))}
      </Stepper>

      <div className="rounded-lg border border-border p-4 text-sm">
        {done ? (
          <p className="font-medium">Order #48213 placed. A receipt is on its way to amina@acme.dev.</p>
        ) : (
          <p>
            <span className="font-medium">{steps[step - 1]!.title}</span>
            <span className="text-muted-foreground">: {steps[step - 1]!.description}</span>
          </p>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex justify-between">
        <Button variant="outline" disabled={step === 1} onClick={() => setStep((s) => Math.max(1, s - 1))}>
          Back
        </Button>
        <Button disabled={done} onClick={() => setStep((s) => Math.min(steps.length + 1, s + 1))}>
          {step === steps.length ? 'Place order' : 'Continue'}
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```
